edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender as the source of the token movement.
approve uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
HelloERC20 constructor mints the initial supply to _msgSender.
The HelloERC20 constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
The HelloERC20 constructor performs the initial 10000e18 mint.
The HelloERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor.
The HelloERC20 constructor invokes the ERC20 constructor.
The HelloERC20 constructor invokes the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
ServicePayer makes an external payable call to the arbitrary receiver address during construction.
msg.value is forwarded as the value of the external pay call.
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount for the new allowance.
_transfer updates sender and recipient balances by subtracting and adding amount.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by amount.
increaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue.
The GeneratorCopyright constructor writes version_ into _version.
The ERC20 constructor writes name_ into _name.
The ERC20 constructor writes symbol_ into _symbol.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads the _allowances mapping.
increaseAllowance reads the _allowances mapping.
decreaseAllowance reads the _allowances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint updates the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn updates the _totalSupply state variable.
generator returns the _GENERATOR constant.
version returns the _version state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor parameter consumed directly by the ERC20 constructor to set _name.
symbol_ is a constructor parameter consumed directly by the ERC20 constructor to set _symbol.
recipient is a parameter of transfer forwarded to _transfer.
amount is a parameter of transfer forwarded to _transfer.
sender is a parameter of transferFrom passed to _transfer.
recipient is a parameter of transferFrom passed to _transfer.
amount is a parameter of transferFrom compared against the allowance.
currentAllowance is a local used for the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
sender is an internal parameter used for the zero-address check and balance update in _transfer.
recipient is an internal parameter used for the zero-address check and balance update in _transfer.
amount is an internal parameter used for the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
senderBalance is a local caching _balances[sender] inside _transfer.
account is the mint beneficiary parameter of _mint.
amount is the minted amount parameter of _mint.
account is the burn source parameter of _burn.
amount is the burned amount parameter of _burn.
owner is the allowance owner parameter of _approve.
spender is the allowance spender parameter of _approve.
amount is the allowance value parameter of _approve.
spender is the allowance target parameter of increaseAllowance.
addedValue is the increment parameter of increaseAllowance.
spender is the allowance target parameter of decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is the decrement parameter of decreaseAllowance.
receiver is the arbitrary payable address used in the external pay call of the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName is passed to the external pay call in the ServicePayer constructor.
name_ is a constructor parameter of HelloERC20 forwarded to ERC20.
symbol_ is a constructor parameter of HelloERC20 forwarded to ERC20.
feeReceiver_ is a constructor parameter of HelloERC20 forwarded to ServicePayer for the external pay call.
version_ is the constructor parameter used to set _version.
account is the lookup parameter of balanceOf.
spender is the allowance target parameter of approve.
amount is the allowance value parameter of approve.
